name: MSI Center
author: Tanmay
description: The msi-center desktop app as a bar summary: CPU temperature, fan speed and level, battery and charge limit, plus the same seven controls — power mode, fan mode, cooler boost, charge limit, keyboard backlight, Fn/Win swap and webcam block. Same sysfs writes as the app, no root helper.

barWidget.description: Summary of the msi-center app. Reads sysfs and writes the same msi-ec attributes the app writes; the udev rule grants the msi-ec group access to exactly those files. No MControlCenter, no helper daemon.

schema.label: Hide the widget when msi-ec is not loaded
